strips.title: A cold week with a heated pad — in real life

panels.head: 6:30 pm — pre-heat
panels.text: Turn the pad on high about 30 minutes before bed (Sunbeam's manual says to preheat), while a heater warms the room for the evening.

panels.head: 10 pm — heater off
panels.text: Turn the room heater off when you go to bed, as Consumer Reports advises, and drop the pad to a low setting.

panels.head: Week 3 — the check
panels.text: Look for frays, dark spots or a controller that blinks. If it does, stop using it and check the model against CPSC recalls.

panels.head: Morning — the bill
panels.text: At 120 W the whole night is about 17 cents at the national average. The heater would have been about $2.18.
